Requires an absolute http(s) url without credentials or fragment, a leaf iso_name without path separators or NUL, both ending exactly with .iso, and a positive nfs_share_id. HTTP 202 status started means accepted only, never downloaded or registered: download, sync or registration can fail later and report notifications. There is no job ID or completion endpoint. Partial files can remain after failure. No automatic retries.

iso_name.description: New leaf ISO filename without path separators or NUL ending exactly with lowercase .iso

nfs_share_id.description: Positive existing NFS share ID on a connected slave

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL without credentials or fragment ending exactly with lowercase .iso

tools.name: start_iso_download

tools.description: Risk: medium. Start the VM. A private prior-state record is saved before mutation. No automatic rollback. Calls POST /virsh/startvm/{vm_name}. No automatic retries.
tools.name: start_vm

tools.description: Stop a Celld fleet while retaining its configuration and data. Returns queued desired_state=stopped (HTTP 202), not completed shutdown. Busy/conflicting operations are reported by HyperHive. No automatic retry.

id.description: Fleet ID returned by list_celld_fleets or create_celld_fleet

tools.name: stop_celld_fleet

tools.description: Replace a proxy host's complete configuration. Calls PUT /proxy/edit. All settings and a positive id are required; omitted settings are rejected, false/zero settings are sent unchanged. Managed frontend proxies cannot be edited (403). The API checks the first domain for management restrictions. Enabled state uses separate actions. No automatic retry.

access_list_id.description: Nonnegative access-list ID; zero means no access list

tools.name: update_proxy
